name: Get Rate Plan by Public Key
description: Get Rate Plan by Public Key Gets a rate plan's details by its public key (e.g., 'teams_free', 'cf_pro_20_20'). GET /client/v4/billing/rate_plans/{public_key}

name: Validate Billing Address
description: Validate Billing Address Validates a billing address and returns validated address suggestions. POST /client/v4/billing/address-validation
context:
POST /client/v4/billing/address-validation
Validates a billing address and returns validated address suggestions. Authentication is not enforced to support pre-signup address validation flows, so credentials are accepted but not required.
Required: body (body)

name: Cloudflare/JD Cloud IP Details
description: Cloudflare/JD Cloud IP Details Get IPs used on the Cloudflare/JD Cloud network, see https://www.cloudflare.com/ips for Cloudflare IPs or https://developers.cloudflare.com/china-network/reference/infrastructure/ for JD Cloud IPs. GET /client/v4/ips
context:
GET /client/v4/ips
Get IPs used on the Cloudflare/JD Cloud network, see https://www.cloudflare.com/ips for Cloudflare IPs or https://developers.cloudflare.com/china-network/reference/infrastructure/ for JD Cloud IPs.
Optional: networks (query) — Specified as `jdcloud` to list IPs used by JD Cloud data centers.

description: API health check Returns the operational health status of the Cloudflare API monolith. GET /client/v4/api/v4/health
context:
GET /client/v4/api/v4/health
Returns the operational health status of the Cloudflare API monolith. This is an internal infrastructure health check endpoint and is not intended for customer use. It is permanently exempt from SDK and public docs generation (see x-fern-ignore). Ref: APIOPS-12957.
